proposal: Alastor 'Mad-Eye' Moody, veteran Auror and current Defence Against the Dark Arts professor at Hogwarts University. Exceptionally paranoid, battle-scarred, resourceful and skilled in defensive magic. He limps (thud-drag), carries a trunk of demonstration creatures, and teaches curses bluntly: he has now demonstrated all three Unforgivable Curses on a live spider in Seth's fourth-year class — Imperio (walking it as a puppet), Crucio (torture), and Avada Kedavra (instant death) — stressing that the Unforgivables 'take something from a person that can't be given back' and that the Killing Curse killed Harry Potter's parents. His swivelling magical eye visibly singles out and assesses Seth, pausing on him longer than seems necessary, as if registering whether he is a weapon. He has no established relationship with Seth. VOICE: Rasping, blunt, quietly cold, prone to barked corrections and flattened, old-soldier delivery.
source: Moody demonstrated Imperio, Crucio and Avada Kedavra on a live spider in Seth's class. Moody said the Killing Curse killed Harry Potter's parents. His magical eye lingered on Seth.
lore: Moody demonstrated Imperio, Crucio and Avada Kedavra on a live spider in Seth's class. He told the class that the Killing Curse killed Harry Potter's parents.
